questions.question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

25 - 48 + 6 ÷ 12 × 2 = 41
questions.solution:
**BODMAS rule:**

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/vvZGJgyUcWRxFYwZDuDccfXc1J4Hv-wJFPUhpgi5my2vRskbP0lrpFiB5bp-Fp1nL7-DAFHVohm7qLOiDiRICqqhpJN3TRD-Ve2GlfJedfFcSqGzHEnUzLGUstVgCswZxtqJaOG9JHTLo12lyFxfeA] 

Option 1) - and +

Interchanged the given mathematical sign in given equation,

We get: 25 + 48 - __**6 ÷ 12**__ × 2 = 41

⇒ 25 + 48 -__** 0.5 × 2 **__= 41

⇒ __**25 + 48 **__- 1 = 41

⇒ 73 - 1 ≠ 41

⇒ 72 ≠ 41

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 2) × and ÷ 

Interchanged the given mathematical sign in given equation,

We get: 25 - 48 + 6 × __**12 ÷ 2**__ = 41

⇒ 25 - 48 + __**6 × 6**__ = 41

⇒ __**25**__ - 48 __**+ 36**__ = 41

⇒ __**61 - 48 **__= 41

⇒ 13 ≠ 41

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 3) ÷ and +

Interchanged the given mathematical sign in given equation,

We get: 25 - __**48 ÷ 6 **__+ 12 × 2 = 41

⇒ 25 - 8 + __**12 × 2 **__= 41

⇒ __**25**__ - 8 __**+ 24**__ = 41

⇒ 49 - 8 = 41

⇒ 41 = 41

⇒ **LHS = RHS**

Option 4) ÷ and -

Interchanged the given mathematical sign in given equation,

We get: __**25 ÷ 48**__ + 6 - 12 × 2 = 41

⇒ 0.520 + 6 - __**12 × 2 **__= 41

⇒ __**0.520 + 6**__ - 24 = 41

⇒ 6.5020 - 24 = 41

⇒ - 17.47 ≠ 41

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and +".**

questions.question: Six persons L,M,N,O,P and Q are sitting in a straight line facing towards the east. Only two persons are sitting to the left of P, who is sitting third to the left of L. M and N are not sitting at any of the ends. M and P are the immediate neighbours of Q. Who is sitting at the second position from the left end?
questions.solution:
**Six persons: **L, M, N, O, P and Q

1) Only two person are sitting to the left of P, who is sitting third to the left of L.

(It means P sits third left from the left end)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afcc0ea7891d757b72b6508d168c239652c12c2f4b12ee006be91f42af2ff0bb.png] 

2) M and N are not sitting at the any of the ends.

3) M and P are immediate neighbours of Q.

(Because M is not sitting at any end so M can sit on second position from right end.)

(N is also not sit at any end so N can sit only second position from left end.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec855e22ea9ec84c9a1ece184725ebab78a8968881c7ac9d181d4ff01e5dc451.png] 

Clearly, we can see that **N is sitting at the second position form the left end.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"N".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'DOME' is coded as '74' and 'PLACE' is coded as '74'. How will 'FLOOD' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f390eb1aa5eef27c267010a8106c7b83cfbeaa1b6c945402f538a1e70a0d41b.png] 

**Logic: Sum of the positional values of the letter × 2**

'DOME' is coded as '74'

→ D(4), O(15), M(13), E(5)

→ 4 + 15 + 13 + 5 = 37

→ 37 × 2 = **"****74"**

And,

'PLACE' is coded as '74'

→ P(16), L(12), A(1), C(3), E(5)

→ 16 + 12 + 1 + 3 + 5 = 37

→ 37 × 2 = **"****74****"**

Similarly,

'FLOOD' is coded as '?'

→ F(6), L(12), O(15), O(15), D(4)

→ 6 + 12 + 15 + 15 + 4 = 52

→ 52 × 2 = **"104"**

Hence, the correct answer is **"104".**
